rows.name: Myeongdong street food stalls ("Myeongdong Night Food Market")
rows.claim: Itinerary: "Myeongdong Night Food Market, 9:00 AM–11:00 PM"
rows.address: Along Myeongdong 8-gil and the main shopping street, Jung-gu, Seoul
rows.notes: There is no officially-operated "Myeongdong Night Food Market" — the evening street-food stalls along Myeongdong's alleys are informal and hours vary by stall and season (typically evenings, busiest 18:00-22:00). No official operator or schedule exists to verify the claimed 9:00-23:00 hours. Treat as a walk-by evening activity rather than a scheduled venue.
rows.transit: Steps from the hotel — Myeongdong shopping street.

rows.name: Lotte Department Store — Main (Myeongdong)
rows.address: 81 Namdaemun-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul (directly across from Stanford Hotel)
rows.hours: Mon-Thu 10:30-20:00 · Fri-Sun 10:30-20:30 · restaurants ~10:30-21:00. Monthly closing day: one rest day per month (date varies — check before visiting).
rows.notes: The real split is Mon-Thu vs Fri-Sun, not weekday/weekend. Day 2 is a Monday → 10:30-20:00. A translated official page indicated a monthly closure on a Monday in November for the Main store — monthly rest days vary; verify near the travel date.
rows.transit: Directly across Namdaemun-ro from the hotel.

sources.label: Lotte Shopping (official) — Main store hours & info

rows.name: Shinsegae — Main Store
rows.address: 63 Sogong-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul (connected to Shinsegae Sogong underground arcade)
rows.hours: Mon-Thu 10:30-20:00 · Fri-Sun 10:30-20:30 · food court (B1) ~11:00-21:30. Monthly rest day varies by month — check before visiting.
rows.notes: Same Mon-Thu / Fri-Sun split as Lotte (not weekday/weekend). Day 2 is a Monday → 10:30-20:00.
rows.transit: ≈5-8 min walk from the hotel along Namdaemun-ro / or one stop on Line 4 (Hoehyeon Station is across from the store).

rows.name: Olive Young — Myeongdong Town flagship (Global Store)
rows.hours: Daily 10:00-22:30 (business days, Saturdays, Sundays and holidays alike)
rows.notes: Claimed hours (8:00-24:00) are wrong — the flagship opens at 10:00 and closes at 22:30. Located mid Myeongdong shopping street; the entire 2F serves international shoppers (tax refund, lounge). Note: Myeongdong now has multiple Olive Young branches (a second flagship, 'Central Myeongdong Town', opened Mar 2026 at Myeongdong 8-gil 27), so opening times can differ by branch.
rows.transit: Myeongdong Station (Line 4) Exit 8, or Euljiro 1-ga Station (Line 2) Exit 5.

sources.label: Olive Young Myeongdong Town (official store page) — hours, address, directions

rows.name: Myeongdong Kyoja
rows.address: Main branch: 129 Toegye-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul (relocated — older listings still show Myeongdong 10-gil 29)
rows.notes: Michelin Guide-listed institution famous for kalguksu and mandu. Verify the current main-branch address on arrival — the restaurant moved in recent years and some maps still show the old location.

sources.label: Michelin Guide — Myeongdong Kyoja (hours, price, location)

rows.name: Gwangjang Market
rows.hours: General market 09:00-18:00 (closed Sundays) · vintage/clothing stalls 10:00-19:00 · food street 09:00-23:00 open year-round
rows.notes: Day 2 is a Monday → general market open; the food street (bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, yukhoe) runs until 23:00, so the itinerary's "to 11 PM" holds for the food alley specifically. If rescheduled to a Sunday, most of the market except the food street closes.
rows.transit: Jongno 5-ga Station (Line 1) or Euljiro 4-ga (Lines 2/5); ≈10-15 min by metro+walk from Myeongdong.

rows.name: Mangwon Market
rows.notes: No official schedule exists — VisitKorea lists Mangwon Market's hours and holidays as "vary by store." The claimed 9:00-23:00 could not be verified. Location note: Mangwon is in western Seoul (near Hongdae), roughly 35-45 min from Myeongdong by transit — an awkward same-day pairing with Myeongdong shopping + Namsan. Consider folding it into a Hongdae-area day instead.
rows.transit: Mangwon Station (Line 6), then a short walk.

sources.label: VisitKorea — Mangwon Market ("hours vary by store")

rows.name: N Seoul Tower (Namsan Tower) — Observatory
rows.hours: Mon-Fri 10:00-22:30 · weekends/holidays 10:00-23:00 · last admission 30 min before closing · open 365 days
rows.price: Observatory: ₩29,000 adult (13+) per VisitKorea. Observatory + cable-car round trip ≈ ₩44,000 ≈ $31-32 — the itinerary's $31 is accurate.
rows.notes: The itinerary's stated hours ("10:00-10:30") are wrong — evenings are fine. Hours may change due to weather. See flag F3.
rows.transit: Bus 01A/01B (₩1,500) from Chungmuro Station, or Namsan Cable Car from Myeongdong Station Exit 3 (10-15 min walk).

sources.label: VisitKorea — N Seoul Tower observatory fee

rows.name: Namsan Cable Car
rows.address: Boarding near the Pacific Hotel, from Myeongdong Station (Line 4) Exit 3, 10-15 min walk
rows.notes: Runs to 23:00, not 10:30. Weather suspensions are possible — confirm on the day. The free Namsan Ormi incline elevator (09:00-23:00, suspended Mon 09:00-14:00) links Namsan Tunnel 3 to the cable-car station.
rows.transit: Myeongdong Station Exit 3 → walk right of Pacific Hotel.

sources.label: N Seoul Tower (official) — By Cable Car (hours, fares, walking route)

rows.name: Hongojib Myeongdong (solo BBQ)
rows.claim: Itinerary (dinner option): "Hongojib — full BBQ for 1 for only $10"
rows.address: 1F, 40 Myeongdong 3-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul (≈90 m from Euljiro 1-ga Station Exit 6)
rows.notes: Brand verified — Hongojib is a solo-diner Korean BBQ chain (individual charcoal grills, tablet ordering, first order ≥150 g of meat). Myeongdong branch is reported to open ~11:00-11:30 and run to ~01:00, and solo sets commonly run ₩12,000-13,000 (≈$9-10, matching the itinerary), but hours and prices are not published on an official page (the official hongojib.com is the franchise site) — values left blank and flagged.

rows.name: Pig Restaurant 2 (돼지래스토랑 둘째)
rows.claim: Itinerary (dinner option listed on Day 2): "premium quality"
rows.address: 1F, 14-1 Bogwang-ro 59-gil, Yongsan-gu, Seoul (Itaewon, a street behind Exit 4)
rows.notes: Real, highly-rated dry-aged pork BBQ in Itaewon (owner grills at your table; ~₩25,000-40,000 per person per reviews). Hours reported daily 16:30-24:00 by third-party listings only (no official website) — flagged. NOTE: it is in Itaewon, ~25-30 min from Myeongdong by transit — a natural fit for Day 7 (Itaewon) instead of Day 2.

sources.label: TourTeller — Itaewon restaurant guide (address, hours, phone)

rows.name: Myeongdong Sookhee (Bar SookHee)
rows.address: 4F, 7-9 Myeongdong 10-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul (above the Starbucks near Myeongdong Cathedral; hidden door)
rows.notes: Verified existence & concept: opulent Korean-style speakeasy (decor inspired by Gyeongbokgung's Geunjeongjeon), whisky/cocktail/wine bar with seasonal-fruit cocktails. Reported hours: daily 18:00-01:00 (last order 00:30); reservations accepted only for 18:00-19:00, walk-ins after. Typical spend ₩20,000-45,000 per person (≈$15-33, consistent with the itinerary). Hours are from consistent third-party/Korean blog listings, not an official site — flagged.

sources.label: Korean review blog (hours, last order, prices)

rows.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
rows.claim: Itinerary: "₩3,000 entry, 3-4 hours, royal guard ceremony 10:00 & 14:00"
rows.hours: Nov-Feb 09:00-17:00 (last admission 16:00) — CLOSED TUESDAYS (if a Tuesday is a holiday, closed the next business day instead)
rows.price: ₩3,000 age 19-64 · ₩1,500 age 7-18 · free age 6 & under and 65+. Combination ticket (4 palaces + Jongmyo) ₩10,000, valid 3 months.
rows.notes: CRITICAL: Day 3 = Tuesday, Nov 3, 2026 → the palace is CLOSED and the guard ceremony does not run on Tuesdays. Move Gyeongbokgung to another day (Day 4-8 all work) or substitute Changdeokgung (closed Mondays instead — open on Tue Nov 3). See flag F2. The ₩3,000 fee, 3-4 h visit length and ceremony times all check out.
rows.transit: Gyeongbokgung Station (Line 3) Exit 5, or Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) Exit 2.

rows.name: Royal Guard Changing Ceremony (Gyeongbokgung)
rows.address: Gwanghwamun Gate & Heungnyemun Gate areas, Gyeongbokgung
rows.hours: Royal Guard Changing Ceremony 10:00 & 14:00 (20 min) · Guard Duty Performance 11:00 & 13:00 · Guard Training 09:35 & 13:35 · NOT held on Tuesdays (palace closed); may be cancelled in rain
rows.price: Free to watch (outside the ticket gate)
rows.notes: Times confirmed — 10:00 and 14:00, ~20 minutes. But again: no ceremony on Tuesday Nov 3. Run by the Korea Heritage Service / Korea Cultural Heritage Foundation.
rows.transit: Gyeongbokgung Station (Line 3) Exit 5 (217 m) or Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) Exit 2.

rows.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
rows.address: Bukchon-ro 11-gil area, Jongno-gu, Seoul (residential hanok district behind Jeongdok Library)
rows.hours: Red Zone (Bukchon-ro 11-gil): tourist visits allowed 10:00-17:00 only — visiting restricted 17:00-10:00 with ₩100,000 fine (enforced since Mar 1, 2025)
rows.notes: This is a residential area under a Special Management Area rule — plan the visit inside 10:00-17:00 and keep noise down. Day 3 is a Tuesday (fine — the restriction is daily, not day-specific). Anguk Station (Line 3) Exits 2/3 serve the village; it pairs naturally before/after Changdeokgung (not Gyeongbokgung on a Tuesday).

sources.label: Seoul Metropolitan Government (official) — Bukchon tourist restrictions notice

rows.name: Crystal Jade (Myeongdong area)
rows.claim: Itinerary: "2 locations in Myeongdong. Go to the Shinsegae Dept Store location - basement floor"
rows.address: B1, Hancom Building, 16 Namdaemun-ro 7-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul (5 min from Euljiro 1-ga Station Exit 7)
rows.notes: The Crystal Jade official site currently lists exactly ONE Seoul restaurant — B1 Hancom Building in Sogong-dong (the Myeongdong-area branch, behind the Westin Chosun / Lotte Avenuel side). A 'Shinsegae Department Store basement' location could NOT be confirmed on official sources; a 'Crystal Jade Shanghai Delight' formerly operated separately (now reported at Hyundai COEX). Use the verified Hancom Building address; call +82-2-3789-8088 to confirm before going if you want a specific branch.
rows.transit: Euljiro 1-ga Station (Line 2) Exit 7, ~5 min walk; near the hotel (≈7-10 min walk).
